recalls.summary: Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2018-2021 Braun-modified Honda Odyssey vehicles.  The fuel tank assembly installed by Braun may be susceptible to the fuel tank overfilling into the charcoal canister.  If the charcoal canister fills with a sufficient amount of fuel, fuel may leak out.
